title: General.
officialText:
A drying room or dry kiln installed within a building shall be constructed entirely of approved noncombustible materials or assemblies of such materials regulated by the approved rules or as required in the general and specific sections of
Chapter 4 for special occupancies, where applicable to the general requirements of Chapter 28, and in accordance with the New York City Fire Code.
